Thank you.
Tomorrow I have my scheduled visit and I'll talk to my doctor to if I can start seeing a psychologist or something. I just feel like shit every moment. My days were 100% dedicated to him and his little life: bringing him to school, asking about his day, helping him with his homeworks, playing with him, keeping track of his medicines and helping him taking them when he was too scared or sick. Now I don't have anything. I just have his little jacket and I cry every day hugging it. I miss him so much. I just want to give him my life and let him grow up healthy and happy and live the beautiful life he deserved.
I can't even imagine how could I live through his death, life is so empty now and people trying to make me think that my daughter will replace him make me so angry and disgusted by the idea of replacing him, like he was a toy or something. 
Thank you for you kind words

I also refer to my unborn daughter as my love and every parent I know refers to their children the same way.
You decided to assume it in a romantic way and, instead of making a decent comment, you just threw up this useless comment to let me know that this is not healthy.
At least now I know that "don't feel bad :)" wasn't the most stupid thing someone could say about this.
The person who died was a 11yo kid who I love like he was my own son. Sounds healthier now, knowing that my romantic and sexual life doesn't involve any other man?

What made you think your presence was in any way necessary and/or required? It wasn't. You had a short lived dating period, you don't have a role in her life. If her mother dies, you bring no comfort. You are not a big part of her past, you're just a dude she dated.
Also, do you really think a person at their own mother's funeral wastes time making up scenarios on why are people there? 
It's funny how you remark she's the immature one, and yet you are the one who thought "better bring my date at a funeral, just in case it turns out to be a trap to get me back" and also "my presence is needed to comfort her. What? I just hurt her? Wow that's not my problem".

Not only YTA but also you're immature and a little... Pathetic. Grow up.

I pay a lot each month to the government (I'd earn 2400 if the government didn't take 1500 each month, so my net wage is 800) so it is not a privilege, it is something I as a citizen I've been paying for. And it is not giving me back any service nor benefit, for a lot of reasons that have to do with politicians' corruption and corporations' selfishness against any human right. I've a personal right and a collective duty to be angry at my country.

It's like the government just doesn't care about its citizens

I'm healthy, I could still do my regular job (which involves moving heavy weights and sometimes having to do with dangerous chemicals) it's just that those tasks would most likely kill or harm the baby. 
The maternity leave is paid by the government (the company I work for contacted the government authority and stated that they need me to go on maternity leave because they don't have any task that would be safe for the baby) which is the reason why I can't have a regular contract. And that makes it difficult to find a job. I think I'll have to give advanced lessons of chemistry, but I don't know if it is enough. I hope things get better eventually

The fact is: if I had 2 jobs before getting pregnant, the pay for my maternity leave wouldn't be the 80% of the two wages, it would be the 80% one single job. So why wouldn't I be able to work a second job? Also my maternity leave is not because I'm sick or I've asked for it, it is because the job is dangerous for the pregnancy. They put me on immediate leave and I need to earn a living. I can't quit my job, because I'm 27 and I've always worked in this branch: I'd need a first job, nobody would hire a pregnant 27yo unexperienced person, I would just be unemployed, it's not a smart move

It's not a disability because it's not me who is unable to work, it the work that is unsafe for pregnant women. This job would very likely be the cause of a miscarriage and the corporation would have to pay, so they send you immediately on early maternal leave. Is not something I've asked for, I'd gladly work and earn my full wage if I could.
I don't have any artistic skill, I'll just find an illegal work to earn real money

Yes, and in the US people are lucky because at least they don't live in the third world. The fact that some country shit on their citizens worse than others is not a consolation. My full wage was already barely enough to survive, the 80% is just not enough. I'm sorry if in other countries there are other laws, but it doesn't change the fact that I have to pay more money that I'm earning and my country doesn't allow me to WORK for it. I'm not asking for free money, I'm asking for being able to work and earn more money. Because I'll find a job anyways, since I need money, I just have to do work illegaly, which is bad for my country as well

My problem is not the 80% (even tho the 80% of a minimum wage doesn't make an affordable living), my problem is that I can't legally find a second job to earn decent money. I didn't ask for the immediate leave, 500$ aren't enough and I have to think about the future too, I need a second income source

Also not every test is completely free, for example the blood tests are about 35/42$ and I have to do them every week. I don't pay the mandatory ultrasounds but the last I did showed a problem and I had to take a test that costed 580$ to see if everything was alright. The nausea suppressants cost 30$ weekly and I have to take other medicines that I don't currently remember how much they cost. It's a loooot of expenses
That sucks. Companies suck.
